prompt: 我们的客服 Agent 的 system prompt 散落在代码各处——有的在 Python 文件的字符串常量里，有的在 YAML 配置里，有的甚至在数据库里。每次修改 prompt 都担心会退化，但没有测试。帮我建立 Prompt 版本管理和回归测试体系。

assertions.description: Provides a strategy for finding and extracting prompts from scattered code locations
Defines a directory structure for prompt version control
Defines regression test cases with expected outputs or behavioral properties
Includes CI/CD pipeline configuration (GitHub Actions or equivalent)
Defines rollback procedure for bad prompt deployments
